Question Choices: Fill: Solve by substitution: $y = 9 - 2x$ and $3x + y = 13$. What is $x$?
Hints: Replace one variable with its equivalent expression, then solve and substitute back.
Solution: System: y=9-2 × x; 3 × x+y=13. Isolate y: y=(-2)x+(9). Substitute into the other equation: (3)x+(1)[(-2)x+(9)]=13. Combine: (1)x=4, so x=4. Then y=(-2)(4)+(9)=1. Check both equations: 2(4)+1(1)=9; 3(4)+1(1)=13. Requested answer: 4.
